idea-plugin.name: Erlang
idea-plugin.description:
Erlang support for IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, RubyMine and other JetBrains IDE.

Feel free to file new feature requests as an issue on GitHub.

If you find this plugin useful, consider making a donation to support the project.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Works in IntelliJ IDEA 2026.1, 2026.2 and 2026.3: one build serves all three
  • Structure view: Autoscroll from Source now selects the function or clause at the caret
  • Variables in named funs: the name and calls in every clause now resolve to the name in the first clause (#438)
  • Completion offers variables for a lowercase prefix when "Match case" is off
  • Unqualified completion and resolve no longer offer functions of the erlang module that are not auto-imported
  • Formatter: with relative indents, the body of a fun whose first clause is on the fun line is now indented from fun, like case and if (#707)
  • Formatter: fixed misaligned multi-line andalso/orelse chains and comments when "Align multiline blocks" is on
  • Integer constant expressions in integer and range types (1..10-1, 0..1 bsl 8) and binary types with both a size and a unit are no longer marked as syntax errors
  • Fixed an exception in the io:format inspection on OTP 27 sigil format strings; ~s/~S sigil formats are now checked
  • fun Var/Arity without a module is reported as an error
  • -export entries that name imported functions or auto-imported BIFs are reported as unresolved
  • Renaming an Erlang module file to a non-module name (e.g. .bak) no longer rewrites the module attribute or the references to it
  • Fixed a false "Undefined or non-exported callback function" warning, and a broken quick fix, for behaviours that declare callbacks as -callback(Name(Args) -> Ret).
  • Fixed false "Unused variable" for a bound variable used as a map key in a fun head
  • Dialyzer findings now use the severity and scopes set for "Dialyzer based inspections" in the inspection profile
  • Fixed Rebar EUnit run configurations failing with "Wrong line separators" when rebar.config has CRLF line endings
  • Fixed builds that silently produced no .beam files: a missing Erlang build plugin, a failing erlc or a module without rebar.config is now reported instead of ending as "successful" (#1077, #1028)
  • Fixed erlc warnings with column numbers (OTP 24+) being reported as errors and failing the build
  • Fixed build order for parse transforms when the IDE and JPS project names differ
  • Fixed false 'multi-valued comprehension' error on map comprehensions (#1093)
  • Quick documentation for OTP functions, types and modules works with the new erlang.org documentation (OTP 27+), including links between pages; documentation is downloaded using the IDE proxy settings
  • Parameter name hints are shorter (parameter name, spec name or a short pattern summary) and can be turned off in Settings | Editor | Inlay Hints | Parameter names | Erlang (#1064)
  • Added support for Erlang/OTP 29 syntax and native records
  • Added support for Erlang/OTP 28 comprehension generators, based float literals and nominal types
  • Added support for Erlang/OTP 27 sigil string literals
